general.title: General
general.description: Set how the app looks and behaves across your workspace.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Which sections this campaign shows, in which order and with which names.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Which template each note type uses in this campaign.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: How notes look and behave while you write, on this device.

general.intro: These preferences update right away so the app matches how you play and run your sessions.

theme.description: Pick the appearance that feels best for everyday use across the whole app.

language.description: Choose the language used in navigation, labels, and messages throughout the app.

fileSizes.label: Show file sizes
fileSizes.description: Show the size of each note, encounter and asset in the file lists of the section pages, on this device.

rules.title: Templates for this campaign
rules.description: New notes in {{campaign}} start from these templates. Automatic uses _templates/<type>.md when it exists, otherwise the built-in.
rules.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to choose which template each note type uses.
rules.saveError: Could not save the template choice

library.empty: Select a template to view or edit it.

create.title: New template
create.description: Creates a template in _templates/ at the vault root.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} will be moved to the Trash. Campaigns using it go back to automatic.

campaignSections.title: Sections of this campaign
campaignSections.description: Reorder, rename, hide or delete the sections of {{campaign}}, or add your own. Deleting a section moves its folder and files to the Trash.
campaignSections.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to set up its sections.

create.title: New section
create.description: A section of this campaign only, with its own folder and note type.
create.typeDescription: Written as type: in the frontmatter of its notes. Leave empty to use the name.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A short line shown on the overview
create.templateDescription: The template new notes of this section start from. Create more in the Templates sheet.

edit.title: Edit section
edit.description: Change the name or the icon. The folder and the note type stay as they are, so the notes keep working.
edit.typeDescription: The note type of an existing section cannot change.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.description: The {{folder}} folder and the {{count}} files in it go to the Trash, where you can restore them.
remove.rewriteLinks: Turn links to its files into plain text and remove their embeds

editor.intro: These choices apply to every note right away, and only on this device.

codeMap.label: Code map
codeMap.description: A map of the whole note on the right, in the editor and in Reading view: each element in its own colour, H1–H3 as labels. Click or drag it to scroll, use the wheel over it, click a heading to jump to it.

lineNumbers.label: Line numbers
lineNumbers.description: Show the line numbers next to the text.

readableWidth.label: Readable line width
readableWidth.description: Keep the text in a centred column instead of using the full width.

defaultView.label: Default view
defaultView.description: How a note opens the first time. Each note then remembers the view you chose.

lineWrapping.label: Line wrapping
lineWrapping.description: Wrap long lines; when off, they scroll sideways (useful for wide tables in Source).

highlightActiveLine.label: Highlight current line
highlightActiveLine.description: A faint band behind the line the cursor is on.

autoClosePairs.label: Auto-close pairs
autoClosePairs.description: Typing ( [ { " or ` also writes the closing one. Selected text is always wrapped instead.

spellcheck.label: Spellcheck
spellcheck.description: Underline misspelled words. Fantasy names will be flagged too.

showSourceView.label: Source view
showSourceView.description: Offer the Source view (raw markdown) next to Live preview and Reading.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.description: Size of the text in the editor and in Reading view.

setup.title: Set up your vault
setup.description: LazyDM keeps your campaigns as Markdown files in a folder you own. Choose an existing folder or create a new one.
setup.cloudHint: Pick a folder inside iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Box or OneDrive to use the same vault on all your devices.

existing.label: Existing vault
existing.description: This folder already contains a LazyDM vault. It will be opened as it is.

empty.label: New vault
empty.description: The folder is empty. A new vault will be created here.

nonEmpty.label: New vault
nonEmpty.description: This folder already has files. LazyDM will add its configuration and leave your files untouched.

errors.desktopOnly: Vaults can only be opened in the LazyDM desktop app.
errors.missing: The vault at {{path}} can't be reached. It may have been moved or deleted, or its cloud drive isn't available yet.
errors.readOnly: LazyDM can't write to this folder. Choose a folder you can edit.

sync.overlayDescription: {{provider}} is downloading notes that changed on your other devices. LazyDM opens the vault as soon as they are on this device.
sync.pendingDescription: {{count}} notes are not on this device yet. They will appear as soon as {{provider}} downloads them.
sync.conflictsDescription: Your cloud service created copies of notes edited on two devices at the same time. Review them and delete the copy you don't need:

list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyDescription: A campaign is a folder in your vault with scenes, characters, enemies, encounters and sessions. Create your first one to start preparing.

create.title: New campaign
create.description: LazyDM creates a folder for the campaign in your vault. Choose the sections it starts with.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A short summary of the adventure
create.presetsDescription: Assets and Encounters are always included. You can add, change or delete sections later.

sections.emptyDescription: Notes you add to the {{folder}} folder of your vault appear here.

newNote.title: New note
newNote.exists: A note with this name already exists in this folder. Choose another title.

scenes.description: Events and moments to run at the table.

enemies.description: Foes, their stat blocks and tactics.

encounters.description: Combats and challenges, ready to run.

handouts.description: Letters, clues and texts to give to the players.

sessions.description: Prep and recaps of each session.

notes.description: Notes without a section of their own.

template.label: Template
template.ariaLabel: Template for new notes in this section

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.description: A sub-folder of {{section}}: its name becomes the sub-type of the notes in it (subtype: in the frontmatter). One level only.
newFolder.specialDescription: A sub-folder of {{section}} to organise its files. One level only.

move.description: The file keeps its name; links to it are updated.
move.noFolders: This section has no sub-folders yet.
move.exists: “{{name}}” already exists in {{folder}}. Rename one of the two files, or move it somewhere else.

renameAsset.title: Rename {{name}}
renameAsset.noBacklinks: No note links to this file.
renameAsset.done: Renamed to {{name}} — {{links}} links updated in {{notes}} notes

toolbar.modeAriaLabel: Switch between writing and reading this note

conflict.title: This note changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Someone — maybe you, on another device — saved a newer version of this note while you were editing. Choose what to do with your changes.

links.noLinkedFiles: No links to or from other files yet.
links.allBroken: All broken links in the campaign

rename.title: Rename note
rename.done: Note renamed — {{links}} links updated in {{notes}} notes
rename.failed: Some notes changed meanwhile and still use the old name

assets.longAudioDescription: Note audio is meant for short sounds. It is saved and will still play.

media.openError: Couldn't open this file — no app can open it

reference.title: Editor reference
reference.description: Everything the editor understands: what you type, and how it shows.

notes.image: Shows the image from the campaign's assets. Drag it to move it in the note.
notes.frontmatter: At the very top of the note: shown as a properties box.

shortcuts.linkSuggestions: Suggest notes and assets to link
shortcuts.wrapSelection: With text selected: wrap it in the typed mark
shortcuts.insertMenu: Right-click: insert formatting, blocks, links and assets
shortcuts.openInNewTab: Cmd/Ctrl-click a link: open it in a new tab

broken.title: Broken links
broken.cardDescription: Links pointing to notes or files that don't exist.
broken.emptyDescription: Every link in this campaign points to an existing note or file.

actions.createDescription: A new note for “{{link}}”: the link will point to it.
actions.removed: Link removed — its text stays in the note

list.title: Compendium
list.description: Material shared by every campaign. Copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly, and copy them back into any campaign.
list.emptyDescription: Create a system — a shared folder for a game, a setting or anything you reuse across campaigns.

create.title: New system
create.description: LazyDM creates a folder in the compendium of your vault. Its folders appear as you add notes and files.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} and the {{count}} files in it will be moved to the Trash. Campaigns are not affected.

system.description: Shared material: copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly.
system.emptyDescription: Create a note, or use “Copy to compendium” on a note or file of a campaign. Folders appear as you add things.

copy.description: A copy of {{name}} is made; the original stays where it is.
copy.noSystems: Create a system in the compendium first.
copy.existsDescription: {{path}} already exists. Choose another name for the copy.

import.description: Choose a file from the {{section}} folders to copy into {{target}}. The original stays where it is.
import.emptyCompendium: The compendium has nothing in {{section}} yet.
import.emptyCampaigns: Your campaigns have nothing in {{section}} yet.

linked.title: Linked files
linked.description: This file links to files {{target}} doesn't have: {{files}}. Files it already has are not copied again.

subfolder.title: Sub-folder
subfolder.description: {{name}} is in the sub-folder “{{subfolder}}” of {{section}}. How should it be copied?
subfolder.fileExists: A file with this name is already in it.
subfolder.merge: The file, into the existing sub-folder “{{subfolder}}”
subfolder.rename: The file and its sub-folder, with another name
subfolder.nameDescription: The file goes into this sub-folder; it is created if it does not exist.

review.title: Review
review.emptyDescription: Every note is in the section of its type and every link resolves.
review.alertDescription: Some notes, folders or links do not match the sections of this campaign.

misplaced.title: Misplaced notes
misplaced.description: Their type belongs to another section.

wrongSubtype.title: Wrong sub-types
wrongSubtype.description: Their sub-type is not the sub-folder they are in.

untyped.title: Notes without a type
untyped.description: Written outside LazyDM (Obsidian, Finder…) without a type: in the frontmatter.

outside.title: Outside any section
outside.description: Notes at the campaign root or in no section folder.

unknownFolders.title: Unknown folders
unknownFolders.description: Folders of this campaign that are not one of its sections. Their notes do not show in the sidebar.

tooDeep.title: Folders too deep
tooDeep.description: LazyDM uses one level of sub-folders: files in deeper folders do not appear in sections.

fixAll.title: Update {{count}} notes?
fixAll.description: Only the frontmatter changes (type and sub-type); every write is checked against changes made meanwhile.

move.title: Move {{title}}
move.description: The note keeps its name; its type follows the section and the links to it are updated.

addSection.title: Add {{folder}} as a section
addSection.description: The folder becomes a section of this campaign with its notes; nothing is moved or renamed.

delete.folderDescription: The {{folder}} folder and the {{count}} files in it go to the Trash, where you can restore them.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.trash: It goes to the Trash, where you can restore it.
delete.linksToText: Turn {{links}} links in {{notes}} notes into plain text
delete.removeEmbeds: Remove {{links}} embeds and links from {{notes}} notes

renameFolder.title: Rename {{name}}
renameFolder.description: The folder is renamed on disk; its {{count}} files keep their names, the notes get the new sub-type, and links through the folder are updated.

deleteFolder.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteFolder.description: The folder holds {{count}} files. It goes to the Trash, where you can restore it.
deleteFolder.moveToMain: Move them to the main folder
deleteFolder.rewriteLinks: When deleting them: turn links to them into plain text and remove their embeds
deleteFolder.clashes: Some names are already taken in the main folder — rename those files first

importFromDisk.title: Import from disk
importFromDisk.description: Images, PDFs and audio files are copied into {{folder}}. Your originals stay where they are.
importFromDisk.dropHint: Drop files here from Finder or your file manager — or drop them anywhere on the Assets page.
importFromDisk.types: PNG · JPG · GIF · WEBP · SVG · AVIF · PDF · MP3 · WAV · OGG · M4A · FLAC
importFromDisk.skipped: Not images, PDFs or audio — skipped

empty.description: Entities you add appear here in initiative order.

entity.name: Name
entity.quantityHint: How many to insert: 1 to 15. Above 1 they are numbered.

conflict.title: This encounter changed elsewhere
conflict.description: A newer version of this encounter was saved while you were editing. Keep your changes, or load the other version.

battle.stopDescription: Initiatives and statuses are cleared and hit points go back to their maximum where there is one. Names and other values stay.

empty.title: The party is empty
empty.description: Add the player characters here once. Add party puts them in any encounter.

roll.hint: Rolls for the selected entities. One that can't roll (a missing value) loses its initiative.

delete.title: Delete {{name}} for good?
delete.description: The entity leaves this encounter and cannot be recovered.

library.title: Battle rules
library.empty: Pick a battle rule on the left, or create one.

create.title: New battle rule
create.description: Creates a rule in _battle-rules/ at the vault root, starting from the built-in one.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} will be moved to the Trash. Campaigns and encounters that used it go back to the built-in rule.

editor.builtInHint: Built-in, read-only. Customize copies it so you can edit it.
editor.conflict: The battle rule changed on disk.
editor.name: Name
editor.templateHint: The frontmatter keys of this template are what the rule can read from an entity's note.
editor.rolled: Roll the initiative from a formula
editor.formulaHint: Dice like 1d20, 1d100 or 2d6, whole numbers, and {key} for a number from the note's frontmatter. A negative number subtracts.
editor.unknownVariable: {{key}} is not an attribute of the template.
editor.fieldsHint: What each entity shows, in order. The name and the initiative are in every rule.
editor.label: Label

row.hint: Drag an element to move it (onto another one to swap them), drag its right edge to resize it, press its gear for its settings, and drop it on the box below to hide it. The name and the initiative stay.
row.label: Mock entity row
row.overlap: That place is taken or out of the row.
row.noRoom: There is no free place left in the row.
row.keyInvalid: The key needs lowercase letters, digits or _ and must be unused.
row.palette: Not in the row · drag in, or click
